scene_summary.room_geometry_visible: Portrait photo of a carpeted room with a bay-window/recess area at the back, visible ceiling, left foreground wall, right wall, and partially visible wall-floor boundaries behind furniture.
main_measurement_risks: floor_wall_edge in bay area is partially hidden by table, chairs and radiator
right floor_wall_edge is partly hidden by chair, plant and sofa/mattress
window frames are obscured by blinds and plants
A4 sheet is on textured carpet and lower edge is near bottom of image
